stem: Alkaline earth metals have valency 2. This means that their position in the modern periodic table is in ____ .
solution: Alkaline earth metals (Be, Mg, Ca ...) have 2 electrons in their outermost shell and valency 2, so they belong to Group 2 of the modern periodic table. Answer: (A) Group 2.

stem: The reaction in which ions in the reactants are exchanged to form a precipitate is called as ____ reaction.
solution: When ions of the reactants are exchanged to form an insoluble precipitate, it is a double displacement (precipitation) reaction, e.g. \(BaCl_2 + Na_2SO_4 \rightarrow BaSO_4\downarrow + 2NaCl\). Answer: (D) Double Displacement.

stem: ____ is used to make a solenoid type coil in an electric bulb.
solution: The filament (solenoid-type coil) of an electric bulb is made of tungsten because tungsten has a very high melting point (about \(3400^\circ C\)) and high resistivity, so it glows white-hot without melting. Answer: (C) Tungsten.

stem: Light changes its direction when going from one transparent medium to another transparent medium. This process is called ____ .
solution: The bending (change of direction) of light as it passes from one transparent medium into another, due to change in its speed, is called refraction. Answer: (D) Refraction.

stem: \(CaO + H_2O \rightarrow Ca(OH)_2 + Heat\) is an example of ____ reaction.
solution: In \(CaO + H_2O \rightarrow Ca(OH)_2 + Heat\), heat is released (evolved) along with the product, so it is an exothermic reaction. Answer: (A) Exothermic.

stem: State whether true or false: A redox reaction takes place during cellular respiration.
solution: True. During cellular respiration glucose is oxidised while oxygen is reduced, so oxidation and reduction occur together, i.e. a redox reaction takes place: \(C_6H_{12}O_6 + 6O_2 \rightarrow 6CO_2 + 6H_2O + energy\).

stem: Find the odd one out: Loudspeaker, microphone, electric motor, magnet.
solution: Magnet. Loudspeaker, microphone and electric motor are devices/appliances that work using the magnetic effect of electric current (or electromagnetic induction), whereas a magnet is only a component, not a device.

stem: What is the reason for twinkling of stars?
solution: Twinkling of stars is due to atmospheric refraction of starlight. As starlight passes through layers of air of continuously changing optical density (refractive index) and temperature, it bends by varying amounts, so the apparent position and brightness of the star keep fluctuating, making the star appear to twinkle.

stem:
Match the columns:

| Column 'A' | Column 'B' |
| --- | --- |
| Simple microscope | (a) used to observe minute objects |
|  | (b) used to see distant objects |
|  | (c) used for watch repair |
solution: Simple microscope \(\rightarrow\) (c) used for watch repair. A simple microscope is a single convex lens (magnifying glass) used by watch-makers and jewellers to see small parts enlarged, so it is matched with 'used for watch repair'. (It magnifies minute objects; option (b) 'to see distant objects' is a telescope, not a microscope.)

stem: Name the behaviour of water between its temperature from \(0^\circ C\) to \(4^\circ C\).
solution: It is called the anomalous behaviour (anomalous expansion) of water. Between \(0^\circ C\) and \(4^\circ C\), water contracts on heating (its volume decreases instead of increasing), attaining maximum density at \(4^\circ C\).
